# Acquaintance Relationship

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:AcquaintanceRelationship`](gmeow-AcquaintanceRelationship.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/AcquaintanceRelationship>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/contacts`](../../slices/contacts.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

An interpersonal relationship of social acquaintance — agents who have met and know one another (the reified form of [`hasMet`](../properties/gmeow-hasMet.md)).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:InterpersonalRelationship`](gmeow-InterpersonalRelationship.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:AcquaintanceRelationship`](gmeow-AcquaintanceRelationship.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:InterpersonalRelationship`](gmeow-InterpersonalRelationship.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:InterpersonalRelationship`](gmeow-InterpersonalRelationship.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the reified form of [`gmeow:hasMet`](../properties/gmeow-hasMet.md) — a social acquaintance tie that must carry its own interval, confidence, or evidence.

### Avoid when

- Avoid it for the bare symmetric fact (use [`gmeow:hasMet`](../properties/gmeow-hasMet.md)) and for a working tie (use [`gmeow:ProfessionalRelationship`](gmeow-ProfessionalRelationship.md)).

### How to use

- Mint the relator, bind its agents with [`gmeow:relationshipParty`](../properties/gmeow-relationshipParty.md), and carry its span with [`gmeow:relationshipInterval`](../properties/gmeow-relationshipInterval.md); it inherits the at-least-one-party axiom from [`gmeow:InterpersonalRelationship`](gmeow-InterpersonalRelationship.md).

### Examples

- ex:acq a [`gmeow:AcquaintanceRelationship`](gmeow-AcquaintanceRelationship.md); [`gmeow:relationshipParty`](../properties/gmeow-relationshipParty.md) ex:lillith, ex:morgan.
